activity_summary: At dinner Mistress Ansell laid the loaf to the notch, two fingers and more, and asked whose fault you thought it was. You said a married couple's, who cannot agree. She called that the first sound doctrine she ever had from you. She told Alse to pour the beer and not to name the couple. Your jaw is whole enough for the crust. The price was not changed. You did not make a second dinner of it.
